sources.title: LFM2.5-350M - Liquid AI Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-350M is a compact LFM2.5 text model designed for edge devices with strict memory and compute constraints. It runs in under 1 GB of memory. Built on the LFM2.5 architecture with extended pre-training and reinforcement learning, it delivers improved chat, instruction-following, and tool-calling performance over LFM2-350M while keeping the same compact footprint ...
